LanguageData.CC_PEv2_SetOut: {PAWN} has set out from the map's edge for {PLACE}, a caravan of one.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_AwayLost: {PAWN} never reached home from {PLACE}: the road took {PAWN_objective}, as the world's roads do. {FACTION} send word that they are sorry.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Homeward: {PAWN}'s days at {PLACE} are over, and {PAWN_pronoun} has set out for home, a caravan of one on the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_HomewardEarly: {PAWN} has left {PLACE} before {PAWN_possessive} days there were done, and is on the road home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoSecond: Nobody else of the colony is free to go.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Away: {0} is away {1}: the road to {2} and back as a caravan of one, and the days there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_WalkOut: {0} walks out with {1} and the others and sets out from the map's edge.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Road: The roads and the weather are the world's own, and {0} meets them as any caravan does.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Cough: {0} may bring the pilgrims' cough home from the crowded road (about {1}%, through the harm budget).
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Home: Home, {0} brings a shell, a lasting memory of the shrine and steadier faith.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_HomeEased: Home, {0} brings a shell, a lasting memory of the shrine and steadier faith, and "{1}" weighs less.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Fellowship: {0} +{1} goodwill when the pilgrim comes home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Shrine: {PAWN} has walked with {FACTION}'s pilgrims all the way to {PLACE}. {PAWN_pronoun} will keep the shrine with them {DAYS} days, and then take the road home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PilgrimHome: {PAWN} is home from {PLACE} with {THINGS}, the shrine still on {PAWN_possessive} mind, and {PAWN_possessive} faith steadier for the road. {FACTION} think the better of the colony for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PilgrimHomeEased: {PAWN} is home from {PLACE} with {THINGS}, the shrine still on {PAWN_possessive} mind. "{EASED}" weighs less than it did, and {PAWN_possessive} faith is steadier for the road. {FACTION} think the better of the colony for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PilgrimHomeEarly: {PAWN} is home from the road to {PLACE}, the pilgrimage cut short.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PilgrimChronicle: {PAWN} walked with the pilgrims to {PLACE} and came home with a shell.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PilgrimCough: {PAWN} has brought the pilgrims' cough home from the crowded road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_BeastGone: The beast isn't here any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Guard: {0} and {1} are away {2}: the road to {3} and back as a caravan of their own, and days walking with the caravan under the colony's flag.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_GuardRide: {0} rides {1} out to the map's edge and sets out.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_GuardWalk: {0} leads {1} out to the map's edge and sets out.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Share: {0} comes home with the colony's share of the profit, about {1} silver, and a trade lesson.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_GuardThanks: {0} +{1} goodwill when they come home, and the league's caravans come half again as often for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_GuardThere: {PAWN} has reached {PLACE} with {BEAST}, and walks with {FACTION}'s caravan under the colony's flag for {DAYS} days before turning for home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_GuardThereAlone: {PAWN} has reached {PLACE} without the beast, which didn't keep up, and walks with {FACTION}'s caravan under the colony's flag for {DAYS} days before turning for home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_GuardHome: {PAWN} is home from walking with {FACTION}'s caravan, {BEAST} at {PAWN_possessive} side, and has set the colony's share down: {SHARE} silver. The league's caravans will come this way more often for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_GuardHomeBeastLost: {PAWN} is home from walking with {FACTION}'s caravan and has set the colony's share down, {SHARE} silver, but {BEAST} didn't come back from the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_GuardHomeEarly: {PAWN} is home from {PLACE} early, the caravan's walk cut short, and with no share.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Bionic: {0} gets {1} for the {2}, fitted by the enclave's surgeon.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Terms: On terms it comes to {0} silver: {1} down now, then {3} instalments of about {2}, one asked for by letter each season.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Default: A missed instalment is a default: {0} think less of the colony, the debt joins its debts, and no lander of theirs comes until it is paid.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Pod: Their surgeon drops in by pod by the trade spot and fits it on {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_WalkIn: Their surgeon walks in from the road and fits it on {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_BionicDoneTerms: {SURGEON} of {FACTION} has fitted {PAWN} with {PART}. The terms are written, and each season a letter will ask for the next instalment.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DefaultWhole: A default is settled whole: only all that is owed will do.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Instalment: {0} silver is carried out to the gate for {1}'s courier.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_DefaultNow: A default: {1} silver owed to {0} joins the colony's debts, and no lander of theirs comes until it is paid.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Bridge_rope: a crossing of rope and plank
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Bridge_piles: a crossing of timber on piles
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoBuilder: The colony has nobody who builds.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Crossing: {0} and the boatmen lay {2} over {1} cells of water and plank both banks, a span at a time.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_CrossingOurs: The crossing is the colony's, and once a year, on their knot night, {0} ask to rest at it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_CrossingName: the crossing on the colony's river
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_CrossingDone: {FACTION}'s boatmen have laid the last span, and the crossing over the colony's river is the colony's own.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_CrossingPart: {FACTION}'s boatmen have gone before the crossing was finished; what they laid is the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_CrossingChronicle: The river folk of {FACTION} laid a crossing over the colony's river.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_KnotRest: {0} and the boatmen rest the night at the crossing, tie their knots, and walk on in the morning.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_OwnerGone: Its owner isn't here any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoCrafter: The colony has nobody else who crafts.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_MarkUnique: {0}'s {1} becomes {2}, with traits of its own and {0}'s name in it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_MarkMaster: {0}'s {1} becomes {2}, with {0}'s name in its label.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_MarkBench: {0} hands it over and watches at the colony's bench while {1} works on it a day.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_MarkCrafter: {0} works beside the master all day, and learns from it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_MarkDone: {SMITH} of {FACTION} has finished at the bench and handed {PAWN} {PIECE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_MarkChronicle: A master of {FACTION} reworked {PAWN}'s weapon at the colony's bench into {PIECE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_MarkGivenUp: {SMITH} couldn't finish the work, and has handed {PAWN}'s weapon back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryLost: On the dry road to the next water, {FACTION}'s herders lost {COUNT} head, so the drovers say.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryAte: The {NAME}'s herd ate {COUNT} of the colony's crops before the herders drove it out of the field.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryGrazing: {FACTION}'s herd is out grazing the colony's far ground, a herder walking its edge.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryStray: Some of {FACTION}'s herd has strayed from the {NAME} into the colony's fields.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryPredator: {THING} has followed {FACTION}'s herd in from the edge, and is stalking it by the water.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryName: the water in the dry year
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_DryRegion: The region hears that the colony shared its water with {FACTION}'s herders in the dry year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoRoomCamp: There's no room on the colony's land for another camp now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_DryCamp: {0}'s herders camp by the colony's water five to eight days with {1} head and their dogs. They ask for hay or grazing, offer milk and a hand with the colony's beasts, and leave a young beast after a good stay.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_DryRisk: It can turn: the herd may stray into the colony's fields and eat some of the crops, or a predator follow it in.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_DryThanks: {0} +{1} goodwill after a good stay, and the region hears of it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_DryTurned: {0}'s herd takes the dry road to the next water, and word will come of what it cost them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_DryGrazing: The herd grazes the colony's open ground by day, and strays into its fields more easily.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PadRaisePaid: {X_nameDef} read the colony's new figure twice and agreed to it: {COUNT} silver every five days.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PadRaiseGone: {X_nameDef} read the colony's new figure, wrote nothing down, and told the enclave's people to pack up.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PadTrespass: {A_nameDef} walked across the enclave's pad, and the factors noticed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PadPod: A pod came down on the enclave's pad this morning with fresh stock for their stalls.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PadPodTribal: At dawn something fell out of the sky onto the strangers' flat place, smoking, and they carried goods out of it to their stalls.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_PadMealsPaid: {FACTION} paid {COUNT} silver for the colony's meals, left at the edge of their camp.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Pad: {0}'s two factors and two marshals rent ground at the colony's edge for ten to fifteen days, lay a small pad by their stalls, and trade every day from the fresh stock the morning's pod brings.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_PadRent: They pay {0} silver every {1} days, left at the edge of their camp.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_PadTrade: Their factor trades with the colony every day, the game's own trading.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_PadBand: Their stock may draw a band of their enemies against the pad.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_PadRaise: The colony asks {0} silver every five days; about {1}% they pay it, else they pack up and go.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_PadOff: The colony's people keep off the pad while it stands, and the factors notice anyone who walks on it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_ArchiveName: the archive kept from the fire
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_ArchiveLabel: the society's books for their cart
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_ArchiveLapsed: {FACTION} can no longer come for their archive, and the books stay where they are.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_ArchiveKept: {X} of {FACTION} has come with the cart and counted the archive: all {TOTAL} there. The society thanks the colony, and leaves it {BOOK} for its keeping.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_ArchiveWronged: {X} of {FACTION} has come with the cart and counted the archive: of {TOTAL}, {WHAT}. A book lost is a thing the world doesn't know any more, and the society will not forget it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_ArchiveOpen: The colony is keeping an archive already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Archive: {1}'s people carry {0} books in and set them down by the colony's stores.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_ArchiveRead: The colony's readers may read them while they are here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_ArchiveLocked: They are kept locked away (forbidden), and nobody reads them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_ArchiveTome: A sealed crate holds a tome that stays shut, and breaking its seal is a wrong.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_ArchiveThanks: When their cart comes with every book there: {0} +{1} goodwill, and one book left with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_ArchiveRisk: A book lost or sold, or the tome's seal broken, is a lasting wrong to {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoBeastLegMod: {0} fit beasts with Alpha Implants' legs, and there are none of those to be had: only their stables.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoBeastLegAge: {0} have no fitted legs for beasts in their age: only their stables.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_BeastLeg: {0} gets {1}, fitted where it stands by the Circuit's beast-doctor.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_BeastLegDone: {DOCTOR} has fitted {BEAST} with {LEG}, and {BEAST} is up and walking on it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_BeastLegFailed: {DOCTOR} couldn't make the leg take on {BEAST}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Stables: {0} goes with {1} to the Circuit's stables to live out its days.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_Young: The young one brought along, {0}, is the colony's in its place.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Stables: {BEAST} has gone with {DOCTOR} to the Circuit's stables.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_StablesYoung: {BEAST} has gone with {DOCTOR} to the Circuit's stables, and {YOUNG}, a young one of its kind, is the colony's in its place.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NewsWhat_stash: An item stash, heard of on the Signal Line's masts.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NewsWhat_wreck: A wrecked ship's cargo, its beacon heard on the Signal Line's masts.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NewsWhat_outpost: A bandit outpost, its talk heard on the Signal Line's masts.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NoMoreNews: The masts heard nothing else worth selling.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NewsStale: The place the masts heard of is gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_News: The game's own site of {0} appears on the world, marked as heard of from the masts at {1}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_Impact_NewsPaid: The silver is carried out to {0} at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NewsTeller: {X} of the Signal Line, from the masts at {PLACE}
LanguageData.CC_PEv2_NewsGone: {X} looked again at the notebook: the place the masts heard of is gone, and no silver changed hands.
